reviews.title: More red than orange
reviews.review_text: We don't get a lot of rain where I live so I haven't had the chance to use this umbrella yet. However I feel it's worth noting (as I bought this item online) that the color is much more red in person than orange. I still decided to keep it because the pattern is cute (I purchased for my daughter). I bought “orange floral” if that wasn't obvious
Says auto but its not it just a regular umbrella with a push button to open. I thought auto open and close meant automatic. They should seriously specify that.

reviews.title: Pretty Color
reviews.review_text: [This review was collected as part of a promotion.] This is a real pretty umbrella. Its just what I needed because Im always losing mine. But either I dont know how to work it or its broke. I can push it up but it wont stay up. The handle doesnt extend either. Its a nice size and a pretty shade of yellow. It has a velcro fastener to keep it closed. It wont get lost in the car. I will have to see if a friend can help me with it. I feel kinda stupid but I cant figure it out.
